verdict.rationale: The dot has its own cloud computer and can implement changes and run builds with permitted local repositories and tools, so it can write and run code itself. Nothing in the evidence describes analyzing user data to produce charts, computed answers, or downloadable files. Handing work to Codex or ChatGPT Work is a separate product and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented data-analysis code execution, chart generation, computed answers from user data, downloadable file outputs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser.
Investigate bugs, implement changes, and run builds using permitted local repositories, developer tools, and skills.
Connect your computer once through your dot's profile to make its local files, code, and apps available for your dot's work.
